name: places-coverage
title: Places Coverage
description: What the service actually has, per language, ranked by readers affected — plus the diagonal, which is the number a product serving one market lives on.
author: shadcn-places
docs: Feed it `/api/locales?min=0&by=readers`. Two numbers per language and `latinScript` says which one means something — a single figure reports Spanish cities at 14% when a Spanish reader gets a correct name for 51% of them.
